translation: Fi gosa durbaa maqaa keenya Ilmaa Israa'el irraa, kan Moshee uumame warra lolaniif — dhibba shan, dhibba afur, dhibba sadi, dhibba lama, dhibba tokko, shan darba tokko, dhibba afur; warri lama, lamatan-lama, lamatani-sadi, lamatani-afur, lamatani-shan — kun hundi Isaan biratti haadha ta'eera.
